endpointUrl.title: OpenAI-Compatible LLM Endpoint URL
endpointUrl.description: Local llama-server, Ollama, LM Studio, or OpenAI API address. The host (http://localhost:8091), the base (http://localhost:8091/v1) or the full chat URL all work.

quizDisplayMode.title: Reading Comprehension Quiz Display Location
quizDisplayMode.description: Choose whether quizzes open as a modal popup, side drawer panel, or full page view.

enforceNPlusOne.title: Enforce i+1 Vocabulary Budget in Persona Replies

characterMemory.title: Characters remember what I tell them
characterMemory.description: Facts you state about yourself in a conversation are kept on this computer and used by the characters later. Sent to the model like the rest of the chat. See and delete them in Settings > Memory.

characterMemoryShare.title: Who may use what I tell a character

memoryMaxFacts.title: Most facts remembered from one message

quizNudgesVocabulary.title: Written quiz answers move my vocabulary
quizNudgesVocabulary.description: After a free-form answer, words you used correctly three times in a row move towards Known, and a word you misused goes back to Learning. Only for answers that really answered the question. Shown after each answer.
